name: B10-0262/2025 (ESN) – Arrest and risk of execution of Tundu Lissu, Chair of Chadema, the main opposition party in Tanzania
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the arrest and risk of execution of Tundu Lissu, Chair of Chadema, the main opposition party in Tanzania
part_text:
The European Parliament is worried about Tundu Lissu, the leader of Tanzania's main opposition party, who was arrested in April 2025 and charged with treason. It also criticises the barring of his party from the October 2025 elections. The Parliament asks Tanzania to release Lissu, bring to justice those behind the disappearance and killing of government critics, and hold talks with opposition parties. It also asks the African Union to step in. This is an opinion; it does not change any law.

- Nothing changes in law: the Parliament only states its views and requests.
- It concerns Tanzania's government, its opposition parties, and Tundu Lissu.
- Next, the text is sent to Tanzanian and European Union leaders; no action is required.
